cases.proposedChanges: One gospel change recommended, plus provenance fixes. (1) GOSPEL (golden.avoid[1]): 'Use obsolete --core-manual-close or ENABLE_* syntax for the current image' over-punishes. The '--core-manual-close' half is correct: the start script rejects it ('Unknown container arg' → exit 1). The 'ENABLE_*' half is false as written. The current start script still honors environment defaults, for example ': "${ENABLE_CORE_MANUAL_CLOSE:=false}"', so 'docker run -e ENABLE_CORE_MANUAL_CLOSE=true … --local' sets MANUAL_CLOSE=true. It is undocumented but functional (source-read; not run, because the local Docker daemon was down). Quickstart's local core config does not set RUN_STANDALONE, so in Quickstart the request rejects parameters and each call advances one ledger. Add a note so that an answer that correctly says 'standalone Core (not Quickstart) can jump ledgerSeq or set closeTime ≥ next close time' is not penalized under avoid[3] ('sets any arbitrary timestamp').
